purpose: Non-admission source discovery for four official 2025-2026 water occurrence, observed disaster damage and wildfire monitoring products; original bytes, commercial rights and scientific model-input status remain separate gates.

entries.name: Global 2025 OPERA DSWx-S1-derived open-water and inundated-vegetation occurrence v1
entries.provider: OpenGeoHub Foundation / Isik, Parente and Hengl (NASA OPERA DSWx-S1 upstream)
entries.spatial_scope: Global mapped coverage of valid Sentinel-1 OPERA DSWx-S1 observations; valid-observation count and spatial support vary by location
entries.temporal_scope: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31; derived release v1, published 2026-05-05; filenames dated v20260425
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Two EPSG:4326 ~0.00027-degree (~30 m) annual integer percentage-of-valid-observation GeoTIFF layers: open water (13.1 GB), inundated vegetation (21.0 GB); nodata 255
entries.note: Publisher version-specific Zenodo record 20021037 identifies CC BY 4.0 and publishes source-listed MD5s for the 13.1-GB open-water and 21.0-GB inundated-vegetation TIFFs. This is a 2025 annual frequency-of-detection product derived from NASA OPERA DSWx-S1, not daily flood event footprints, water depth, flood return periods, claims, or statistically independent of the underlying DSWx-S1 collection already catalogued in OpenCatastrophe-data. For a later bounded original-byte challenge, record exact TIFF filename, original MD5 and locally computed SHA-256, geotransform, nodata=255, valid-observation denominator and coverage. Distinguish derived-product CC BY 4.0 from upstream/hosting and attribution obligations; never auto-admit data or 34.1 GB in Git.

entries.name: Indonesia BNPB 2025 provincial disaster events, damaged houses and human impacts XLSX compilation
entries.spatial_scope: Indonesia; province-level national statistical compilation; no geocoded individual damaged buildings
entries.temporal_scope: Disaster incidents occurring in 2025; BNPB public source created 2026-07-01, last updated 2026-07-08
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Multiple downloadable original official XLSX resources for incidents, casualties, affected/displaced people and number of damaged houses by province; published snapshot is aggregated and may require a separate peril classification
entries.note: Official BNPB portal identifies the 2025 compilation and provincial XLSX resources; Indonesia's national data.go.id mirror records release on 2026-07-24 and warns that its One Data Indonesia compliance remains in progress. The source portal's July 8 modification date is not the event year. Public classification 'terbuka' indicates discoverability, not proven commercial redistribution or machine-bulk rights. No original XLSX downloaded or hashed here. Identify exact house-damage severity categories, province boundaries, duplicated event reporting and peril mix before quantitative comparison; regional reported counts are neither building-level footprints nor insured losses, and absent entries are not zero losses. Earlier BNPB DIBI 2015-2024 and InaRISK map candidates are different products.

entries.name: Malaysia DOSM Special Report on Impact of Floods 2025 by state and sector
entries.spatial_scope: Malaysia; reported national, state and selected district aggregates; no identified insured property or event polygon
entries.temporal_scope: Flood damage during calendar year 2025; official release 2026-04-15 and 2024 comparatives
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official survey-based and administrative-source aggregate flood damage in Malaysian ringgit by state and sector including residential, vehicles, business, manufacturing, agriculture and public infrastructure; reported national loss 636.9 million MYR
entries.note: Publisher states living-quarters, vehicle, business and manufacturing amounts arise from a January-December 2025 special survey, while agricultural and public-asset infrastructure values use government-agency information; the national aggregate is MYR 636.9 million (vs MYR 933.4 million in 2024), NOT insured claims. The publisher page and downloadable infographic may have inconsistent state-sector labels, so freeze the exact official report/metadata and resolve tabular values before ingesting any subnational cell. No exact original publication bytes or independent rights/redistribution authorisation obtained. Preserve MYR reference year, sector treatment, sampling uncertainty, reporting bias and possible overlaps; do not treat aggregates as event-specific building loss or direct GUL/IL/RI/OEP/AEP.

entries.name: DLR EOC Burnt Area Daily NRT Global v2.2, 2026 product
entries.spatial_scope: Global DLR product; exact footprint availability and observation support must be checked for the selected data tile/time window
entries.temporal_scope: Version 2.2 released 2026-06-23; provider listed a recent rolling 2026 observation window on its public product page, not a complete historic catalogue
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public DLR EOC Data Portal near-real-time burnt-area dataset metadata; exact native grid, variable classification, original event identity, update interval, access endpoint and bounding window pending original product probe
entries.note: DLR's original EOC Data Portal lists global Burnt Area Daily NRT version 2.2, release 2026-06-23, under CC BY-NC 4.0. This explicitly blocks assuming permitted commercial insurer/risk-model use without another licence. Keep it distinct from DLR's separate Europe Sentinel-3 daily/monthly/yearly products and from JRC EFFIS; shared sensors or algorithms may make comparisons non-independent. No original pixels/feature data, endpoint contract, SHA-256 or scientific validation obtained. Resolve spatial coverage, time-window completeness, fire/perimeter semantics, cloud/false positives, and rights before a one-event probe.
